all_words.explanation: A genome is the complete set of DNA in an organism, so the two terms are closely related in meaning.
An accordion is a musical instrument and has no connection to genetics.
Sequencing is the method used to read a genome, so the two words belong to the same scientific topic.
A mackerel is a fish and is unrelated to genomes or genetic research.
Chromosomes carry the genes that make up a genome, so the word is directly linked in meaning.
A trombone is a brass instrument and does not relate to genetics.

explanation: A genome is the complete genetic material of an organism, which is stored in chromosomes made of DNA and read through sequencing; the other words belong to unrelated fields.
